purpose: City-specific parcel-source research; reported registry and public geometry findings are limited to observed evidence.
name: Antofagasta

queries.query: Antofagasta Chile official cadastral parcel map GIS property parcels
queries.result: Found the official SII territorial-tax cartography description, the official Chile Geoportal Predios metadata naming Antofagasta among covered communes, and official MINVU/IDE map services. The Geoportal metadata links a downloadable SHP dataset.

queries.query: Antofagasta catastro predial mapa parcelas oficial municipal
queries.result: Found the official Geoportal/MINVU Predios dataset covering Antofagasta and the municipal 2025 avalúos PDF. The municipal PDF is tabular tax-roll evidence, not a parcel geometry service; no municipal parcel API was verified.

officialSources.custodian: Ministerio de Vivienda y Urbanismo, Centro de Estudios de Ciudad y Territorio
officialSources.observation: Official metadata for the Predios dataset explicitly includes Antofagasta. It describes 2019-01-02 parcel-division data and provides an SHP download link; the dataset is national-agency custody, not municipal custody.

Official SII page states that its Cartografía Digital shows the spatial location of a property and cadastral/tax attributes. It was treated as authoritative service documentation only; no owner or address query was made.
Official municipal 2025 non-agricultural property assessment roll for comuna 02201 Antofagasta. It contains tabular roll/address/tax information and was not retained or queried for personal data.

requests.outcome: Downloaded the official archive to ignored scratch storage. The Antofagasta component contains 123771 Polygon features, EPSG:32719 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 19S), and DBF fields COMUNA, CUT_COM, CUT_REG, CUT_PROV. No stable native parcel identifier field was exposed; no polygon was retained.
Anonymous HTTP 200 metadata response for Propiedad_Fiscal, a polygon layer described as fiscal-property coverage for Región de Antofagasta. Schema was inspected without requesting unsafe fields.

Bounded exact-WUP-point query with geometry and OBJECTID only returned one large fiscal-property polygon (OBJECTID 4). It was not retained because this is fiscal-property coverage rather than verified general cadastral parcel coverage.

registryEvidence.basis: A first-party national cadastral/parcel dataset explicitly covers the Antofagasta commune and was downloaded and inspected. The evidenced custodian is MINVU/Geoportal, not the municipality.

source.name: Geoportal Chile / MINVU Predios
source.identityDecision: No stable native parcel identity field was exposed in the Antofagasta shapefile schema; driver FID was not used as a retained identity.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official MINVU metadata lists Antofagasta among the communes covered by the Predios parcel-division dataset.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The downloaded Antofagasta shapefile contains 123771 polygon features and an EPSG:32719 CRS; citywide completeness and currentness beyond the 2017 source are not established.

pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP point; no coordinate shift was used.
priorEvidenceAssessment: No prior Antofagasta packet was used as evidence.
registryBasis: Official MINVU/Geoportal parcel dataset covers Antofagasta; local municipal custody was not established.
